method:
Reuse the complete prompt with Nano Banana Pro, keeping the broad black fedora, black turtleneck and solid red backdrop. Cast the hat shadow across the upper face while leaving the eyes readable. Adjust light direction or background colour, then check the eyes, lips and separation between hat and backdrop.

Limitations: The archive is 833 × 1199 pixels; the prompt fixes no ratio. The proposed Studio 2:3 is an approximate starting format and must not crop the source media. The eyes remain visible in the example despite the strongly worded deep-shadow instruction. This intensity variation is disclosed, not described as exact reproduction.

variants.promptText: Dramatic avant-garde fashion portrait of a pale woman, high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting, wearing a wide-brimmed black fedora hat and a fitted black turtleneck. A sharp, curved horizontal shadow falls across her eyes and the bridge of her nose, casting the upper face into deep shadow while brightly illuminating her lower face. Glossy bright crimson red lips, subtle freckles, sculpted jawline, smokey eye makeup, striking blue-grey eyes peering through the shadow. Vivid solid red background, cinematic editorial photography, shot on 85mm lens, f/1.8, ultra-detailed skin texture, high fashion magazine cover style.
